## Research focus

```{=html}
<div class="section-intro">
My research spans the complete experimental–numerical workflow: test design and instrumentation, multiaxial and shear characterisation, full-field measurements, and finite-element models from the microscale to the laminate level.
</div>
```

```{=html}
<div class="card-grid home-focus">
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Multiaxial testing</h3><p>Biaxial and multiaxial characterisation, cruciform specimens, combined tension/compression loading, test design and stability.</p></div>
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Composite mechanics</h3><p>Non-linear and pseudo-ductile response of angle-ply CFRP laminates, shear-dominated behaviour and failure mechanisms.</p></div>
  <div class="info-card"><h3>Numerical modelling</h3><p>Finite Element Analysis, mainly with Abaqus, including micromechanics, damage initiation, progressive failure and virtual testing.</p></div>
</div>
```

## Teaching

My current teaching activity is centred on **Resistencia de Materiales** and **Mecánica del Sólido Deformable**, particularly in the Bachelor's Degree in Aerospace Engineering at the School of Industrial and Aerospace Engineering of Toledo (UCLM).
